Title: Stainless Steel Braided Double Row Front and Rear Fish Scale Alloy Magnetic Buckle Bracelet with Keel Jewelry
Jewelry description:
This is a bold, highly–polished silver stainless-steel bracelet designed with a dense woven chain pattern. Each link interlocks tightly with the next, creating a thick, braided texture that gives the bracelet a rugged yet refined look. The surface has a mirror-like shine, reflecting light cleanly along the curves of the links, which enhances the feeling of depth in the weave.

The bracelet is uniform in width all the way around, giving it a solid, substantial presence on the wrist. The edges are rounded and smooth so it looks comfortable to wear despite its heavier, masculine style.

At the center is a sleek, rectangular magnetic (or fold-over style) clasp. The clasp is smooth and minimal — free of engravings or textures — and it blends into the bracelet seamlessly, making the closure almost invisible when fastened. The clasp finish matches the chain perfectly, keeping the entire bracelet cohesive and polished.

Overall, it has:

Material: stainless steel

Color/finish: bright silver, high polish

Design: woven / braided chain

Style: modern, masculine, and durable — suitable for everyday wear or dressier outfits
Notes: No options. Silver and 21 cm length
